leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a typed form state object with TypeScript interfaces
Implement validation functions that enforce type constraints on form fields
Configure a form handler to manage user input and state updates
Bind form controls to typed state properties with proper event handling
Initialize form values with default data while maintaining type safety
Manipulate form state through controlled input components
Integrate validation logic into form submission workflows
lessonTitle: Build typed form library core APIs
